item.title: When caring for aging family members becomes cost prohibitive
item.description: AARP reports family caregivers are spending 60% more than they were five years ago. Journalist Paula Span discusses the rising costs of caregiving and senior living, and the options available to us.
item.content:encoded: AARP reports family caregivers are spending 60% more than they were five years ago. Journalist Paula Span discusses the rising costs of caregiving and senior living, and the options available to us.

item.title: For Ukraine's Kherson region, a short ceasefire meant a momentary return to normal life
item.description: In Kherson city, usually seething with Russian drones, friends met at cafes, families were out together and shoppers stocked up. "The city seems alive," said one resident, "just like it used to be."

item.title: Control of Congress is at stake today. And, judge to consider motion in Clancy case
item.description: Election Day is here, and voters are heading to the polls in an election that may change control of Congress. And, a judge is considering whether to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case.

item.title: Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing
item.description: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, President Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.

item.title: New restrictions at Texas Tech are changing what professors can teach
item.description: The rules have led to changes in course materials, prompted accusations of censorship and fueled pushback from faculty and students, including faculty departures, student protests and a federal lawsuit.

item.title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
item.description: One last check in with the Swing Shift voters before Election Day. All of them voted for President Trump. Now, they're rating his presidency and deciding who to support when he's not on the ballot.
